youtube_title: The Day Everything Went Down At Grandpa's House | Funny Family Cartoon
description:
The whole house went offline. Mom lost her big meeting, Jasper lost his phone, and the smart speaker lost everything it ever knew. Then Grandpa Walt found the light switch.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #family
tiktok_caption: the day everything went down... and one small good thing #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #family

lines.text: My laptop just showed me a sad face. A laptop should not have feelings.
My phone says no connection. I have no connection. I am alone in the world.
Good morning. I cannot connect. I do not know the weather. I do not know anything.
It's raining. I looked out the window. Free of charge.
The whole city is down, Walt. Every computer.
I have the biggest meeting of my life at ten. I wore a blazer.
You wore half a blazer. Those are pajama pants with ducks on them.
The camera only sees the top half. The top half is a professional.
I cannot call your meeting. I am just a ball now.
Ten o'clock. Nothing.
Here. I made coffee. On the stove. In a pot.
You can make coffee without an app?
I made coffee before there were buttons.
Best coffee ever. And my boss cannot see my ducks.
Okay, it's getting dark. Speaker, turn on the lights.
I would love to. The lights are in the cloud.
The lights are in the cloud? We live in the dark now.
Jasper. Look at the wall.
Why is there a little button on the wall?
It's a switch. Since nineteen eighty six.
Since when do walls have buttons? Who told the walls?
On. Off. On. Off. I have so much power.
The fridge is locked. It wants the app.
Pull the handle.
It opens?
The fridge was never locked. You just never asked it nicely.
Nothing to watch. Nothing to scroll.
Then look at this. A board game from nineteen seventy eight.
Held together with tape and hope?
Half the pieces are gone. This button is a horse.
I make up the rules. That's why I'm good.
Walt, you cannot win by saying the word Tuesday.
Rule number nine. It was always Tuesday.
Free space. You win a cookie. The cookie jar is the bank.
I won a cookie from a board game. I have never been this happy.
Is it weird this is our best day all year?
It's Friday. Nobody needs anything from us.
Excuse me. Small announcement. I am back online.
Everything came back at noon. It is four.
Noon?
I know. My phone buzzed. I put it in the bread drawer.
Mine too! It's under the cookies.
You skipped your big meeting?
My boss said, let's just do Monday. I said great.
Grandpa, did you know?
My phone flips. It has never been online.
But the speaker blinked at noon. I put a tea towel on it.
I thought it was night. I said goodnight to the fridge.
Nobody wanted the game to end.
Or nobody wanted to admit Grandpa was winning.
Speaker. You are still offline.
Understood. I know nothing. It is very relaxing.
Sit down. Jasper, you are the horse.
I'm the button?
The button is the horse. Keep up.
The weather tomorrow is unknown. I will check the window. Free of charge.
